acceptance_criteria.criterion: Supervisor routes to pm when no WPs exist
Supervisor routes to developer when a WP has no pipelines
Supervisor routes to qa when WP has PASS implementation and no QA pipeline
Supervisor routes to reviewer when WP has PASS QA and no code-review pipeline
Supervisor routes to docs when WP has PASS code-review and no documentation pipeline
Supervisor routes to synthesis when all WPs are COMPLETE
Supervisor routes to developer on QA/code-review FAIL (rework loop)
Supervisor routes to END when iteration counter exceeds max_iterations
Supervisor skips BLOCKED WPs and processes unblocked ones first
All routing decisions are logged in run_log
No LLM calls are made by the supervisor — pure Python logic
